inlines.v: SCOUN'DREL, noun [Latin abscondo. ] A mean, worthless fellow; a rascal; a low petty villain; a man without honor or virtue. Go, if your ancient but ignoble blood has crept through scoundrels ever since the flood. SCOUN'DREL, adjective Low; base; mean; unprincipled.
